title: Booze Fighters take over Hollister, stealing the headlines

tellings.quote: what happened was a bunch of World War veterans who were in a motorcycle gang called the Booze Fighters, which is a play on Foo Fighters, took over uh Hollister, California for a day and had a drunken party downtown.

plain: In 1947, a motorcycle gang of veterans of the world wars called the Booze Fighters took over Hollister, California for a day and threw a drunken party downtown, grabbing the headlines. The physicist John Brandenburg tells Michels about it, and he notes that the gang's name was a play on "foo fighters", the wartime pilots' name for strange lights in the sky. He tells it as a story he has heard and does not name a source. In his telling, the riot pushed other news of that summer off the front pages.
